payload.vision_scope_stated: Complete across the M1 chain: big idea + to-be scene + goal system (conflicts named) + Moore pitch (draft_vision); as-is pains with witnesses (define_actual); RAID opened (log_risks); gap-claim / why-now / value-props with pass lines (frame_delta); scope + non-goals (scope_non_goals); press release + hostile FAQ (prfaq). Scope = phone-connect toolbar + local-QR pairing + the offer-reappear fix + the refine machine-variant; non-goals = the book, other icons, non-ntfy channels, the i8 bless mechanics, inbound QR, the general lean strike-list, live owner-physical pairing, and i9/ETA work.
payload.problem_agreed: The delta is real and witnessed TODAY, not theoretical. i8 shipped the from-away bless but left no way to pair a real phone - the lane has never run against a device (i8 ship review, this retro's field feedback, open se.raid-phone-live-pairing). The offer flicker-back was observed LIVE this session on the owner's own kickoff bless. The front-heavy reuse walk is exactly what se.decision-refine-mode was ruled to fix. The goal is worth having: one gesture turns a shipped-but-untested lane into a testable one, and makes from-away adjudication a real choice rather than the only fallback when the owner steps out.
payload.prior_art_positioned: Positioned against the scanned field: hand-editing the config sheds usability; a hosted QR API sheds security (it leaks the topic, which is the credential); ntfy subscribe-by-typing sheds the one-gesture property. None keeps all three of gesture + secrecy + one-click install. The direct predecessor is i8's own lane - it shipped and mock-proved the hash-bound, channel-stamped bless path; i8b adds only the missing pairing on-ramp and does not touch that path.
payload.success_measurable: Every need carries a mechanical pass line (frame_delta value-props): the connect action writes phone.json enabled with a generated topic and the board renders that QR (test); the encode path makes no external network call, the topic is sent nowhere (test); after a clear, no later tick re-surfaces a consumed offer (red-first test); i8b's compiled machine has no M2/M4/M5 states and walks M1 -> M3 -> the one config-write decide -> M6 -> M7-M9 (test). The single owner-physical pass line - the owner scans and blesses from away - is carried as a RAID trigger.
payload.risks_logged: The register is open (log_risks) with owners and triggers: R1 the QR dependency, vetted at the ship-review (se.meth-dependency-ship-review); R2 editing i8b's live machine to apply the refine strikes (trigger: the switch before M2); R3 the reappear fix is a client poll race and a client-only fix may miss a server re-publish (trigger: the red-first test at M7); A1 topic-possession authenticity accepted (owner-ruled, se.adr-answer-authenticity); D1 the live owner-physical pairing, carried as se.raid-phone-live-pairing.
